title: The Ribbon Replaced on the Bear
youtube_title: The Ribbon Replaced on the Bear | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Gratitude shows up in what you do next.
summary: At a workshop with tools on a low peg, Ximena notices that Papa has already taken care of a ribbon replaced on a bear that had lost it. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Ximena does one useful thing Papa did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
